pr_title: feat: disable canvas smoothing (antialiasing) for right-angled elements (#6186)Co-authored-by: Ignacio Cuadra <67276174+ignacio-cuadra@users.noreply.github.com>
pr_body:
fix https://github.com/excalidraw/excalidraw/issues/6171

Disables canvas smoothing for all right-angled elements (0°, 90°, 180°, 360°), which improves rendering on Chromium-based browsers, making shapes and especially text less blurry. Non-right-angled shapes (i.e. when we rotate the canvas to a non-right angle) seems to result in super crazy aliasing (might be a bug in Blink).


Test it out:

- this PR: https://excalidraw-hbzidjm0n-excalidraw.vercel.app/#json=47qMGDyfF3arke3jQ6Ixf,EjE80jzDkFO6OHlcjjxLIw
- production: https://excalidraw.com/#json=47qMGDyfF3arke3jQ6Ixf,EjE80jzDkFO6OHlcjjxLIw

After, smoothing disabled:

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/5153846/216313027-a9996a8c-7f7d-47f7-b8c5-7d7e55346839.png)

Before, Smoothing enabled (production):

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/5153846/216313046-083fe4bd-141a-4808-8d98-d540c17703f0.png)

zero-angle vs non-zero, non-right angle:

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/5153846/216401387-ab76355d-e544-4c49-909f-8eb8436e8d68.png)

issue_context.title: BUG: fuzzy Chinese characters
issue_context.body:
**Your environment**
```
SYSTEM INFO:
	Obsidian version: v1.1.9
	Installer version: v0.15.8
	Operating system: Windows 10 Home China 10.0.22000
	Login status: not logged in
	Insider build toggle: off
	Live preview: on
	Legacy editor: off
	Base theme: dark
	Community theme: none
	Snippets enabled: 0
	Restricted mode: on
```


**Describe the bug**
Chinese character sometimes can be very fuzzy while adjusting the size of its outer box.

**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
- Click Rectangle
- Draw a Rectangle A
- Double click the center position of A
- Write "基本参数设定"
- Keep changing the size of A

**Expected behavior**
Characters should not be fuzzy.

**Screenshots**
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/16933298/215421434-a2ef029b-5b26-482c-b8cd-f512f3f56929.png)
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/16933298/215421453-fb062428-a4f5-44b5-a232-df552f343563.png)
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/16933298/215421462-982917df-74f9-42e8-a7ac-689c25ea3b49.png)

We tried to improve it, but didn't work. What's your screen resolution + scree size (or dpi) ~~and browser~~ (didn't notice it's Obsidian. So chromium — which is known to make shortcuts when rendering for better speed. But it's a problem in general.)?
